==Biography==
Marcelo '''"Riyev"''' Carrara is from Corumbá, Mato Grosso do Sul. He joined [[JAYOB e-Sports]] in the end of December 2014 to play as the team's support in [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 1|2015 CBLOL Split 1]]. After the announcement of his one-year ban in February 2015, he moved to the coaching staff. In May he left the team, and one month later he joined [[KaBuM! Black]] as an analyst.

== Trivia ==
* Received one-year ban in February 2015 due to Elo Boosting.<ref>[http://mycnb.uol.com.br/noticias/2341-support-do-jayob-riyev-e-banido-do-competitivo-por-elojob Support do Jayob, Riyev é banido do competitivo por elojob (Portuguese)] ''mycnb.com.br''</ref>
* Was hostilized by the Brazilian community due to publicly criticizing [[Theusma]] when the AD carry was released by [[JAYOB e-Sports]].
* After his retirement he moved to the countryside in Brazil to work in a farm.<ref>[https://x.com/CBLOL/status/2037182753276313976 CBLOL's X Post (Portuguese)] ''x.com''</ref>
